text:
Lena: Heads-up: AcmeCloud wants a joint launch with one of our SIs + hardware partner next month. Need a quick playbook for who claims what on accounts, marketplace listing sync, and announcement timing. Can we sketch rules today? @Ravi @Tom-SI @Nina
Ravi: yay, exciting. Quick constraints: sales needs exclusive claim for demo-to-opportunity accounts for 7 days post-demo. After that SI can claim for co-sell if they brought partner engineering.
Tom-SI: from SI side, we ask for 5 business days to validate tech fit before co-commit. If sales claims first, SI still wants credit if they did integration work. We need evidence rules.
Nina: marketing note: announcement date is fixed 2026-05-15. We need partner approvals by 2026-05-01 for co-branded assets. Marketplace listing (AcmeCloud Marketplace) should go live 2026-05-10 to build momentum.
Lena: okay timeline locked. Proposal: create a short RoE doc + canonical mapping CSV and a weekly adjudication window on Fridays. During the window, conflicts get resolved.
Carlos: ops-bot can run a weekly overlap check and post candidates to #partnerships-review. I'll queue a job.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: "si-marketplace-overlap-check" running Fridays 09:00 PT. Report URL: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/si-marketplace-overlap
Ravi: evidence rules suggestion: acceptable evidence = recording link with demo timestamp, signed NDAs, or signed SOW. For quick wins we accept meeting invite + notes but mark confidence low.
Tom-SI: add a "technical-ownership" flag: did SI deliver a prototype or integration sample? set true/false. That helps credits during adjudication.
Nina: marketing asks for a canonical partner-blurb and logo approval checklist in the CSV so we can QA listings easily. Also need exact SKU mapping for marketplace listing (bundle vs single product).
Lena: CSV headers I'm thinking:
```
account_id, account_name, region, sales_owner, si_partner, hw_partner, claim_ts, claim_type, evidence_link, technical_ownership, marketplace_sku, marketing_blurb_status
```
Tom-SI: add `integration_repo_link` and `poe_contact` (point of engagement) please.
Ravi: agree. Also a `claim_priority` (hot/warm/cold) based on ARR bucket.
Lena: good. Rules draft: 1) First-claim rule for demo->opportunity for 7 days. 2) SI can claim concurrently if they have technical_ownership=true. 3) Hardware partner claims require at least joint engineering validation. 4) Escalation path: sales rep -> SI lead -> Lena -> Exec arb within 48h. 5) Marketplace sync cutoff = 5 business days before announcement.
Carlos: I'll make the scripts to annotate CSV with confidence score, duplicates, and `marketplace_ready` boolean.
Nina: will prep a one-pager marketing checklist and a sample SKU mapping spreadsheet. Expect draft tomorrow.
Tom-SI: one sticky: global accounts where EMEA and APAC teams parallel-claim. Proposal: region-scoped claim windows and a canonical global owner field to avoid churn.
Ravi: region windows sound right. Let's have claim windows: Americas 09:00-11:00 PT, EMEA 16:00-18:00 CET, APAC 10:00-12:00 SGT. Overlaps outside windows flagged for manual triage.
Lena: pilot: run this for the AcmeCloud launch. Carlos, ops-bot, can you post the weekly report starting this Friday?
Carlos: yes, report scheduled. I'll attach a sample CSV with two rows for Acme pilot by EOD.
ops-bot: report posted: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/si-marketplace-overlap/2799991111 (contains diffs and confidence scores) :robot_face:
Nina: once we have the canonical CSV, marketing will lock the asset approvals. Reminder: legal needs 3 business days for partner logo usage signoff.
Lena: solid. Action items: Ravi draft evidence policy, Tom-SI provide `technical_ownership` definition + sample repo links, Nina draft marketing checklist, Carlos schedule/attach CSV, Lena finalize RoE and run adjudication for pilot. We'll reconvene Thursday 11am PT if needed.
Ravi: I'll drop the evidence policy doc link in this thread when ready.
Tom-SI: sharing sample integration repo link in 30m.
Nina: draft checklist incoming.
Lena: thanks all. Let's try to keep claims in the windows to reduce friction. :pray:
